attempts.raw_response: Furthermore, a new regulation was introduced regarding the standardization of healthcare services provided by private clinics. This legislation mandates that all facilities must adhere to strict hygiene protocols and maintain transparent pricing structures for common procedures. The goal is to protect patients from unexpected costs while ensuring high standards of medical care across both public and private sectors. Additionally, the amendment includes provisions for regular inspections by health authorities to verify compliance with these new standards. Critics argue that the implementation timeline is too aggressive, potentially causing short-term disruptions in service availability. However, proponents emphasize that long-term benefits will outweigh initial challenges, fostering greater trust in the healthcare system. Meanwhile, educational institutions are preparing for upcoming curriculum reforms aimed at integrating digital literacy into primary education. These changes reflect a broader governmental strategy to modernize key societal pillars and enhance overall quality of life for citizens through improved regulatory frameworks and accessible services.

pair.human_continuation:
Amendment to the Tenant Rights Law in public housing, which regulates the distribution of rights in public housing in case of separation of spouses.
 Amendment to the Administration & Law Ordinance (Abolition of Law, Jurisdiction and Administration), which was initiated during the 17th Knesset with Avigdor Yitzhaki. The amendment states that an agreement or government decision, according to which the law, jurisdiction and administration of Israel, will not apply to a territory, will require the approval of the Knesset and will be brought to a referendum. The law also regulates the way to conduct a referendum.
 Amendment to the Computers Law that prohibits the editing and transfer of software that causes damage to a computer or computer material, even if there is no actual damage, if it was done in order to penetrate the computer, to perform actions that result in false information or output or to perform secret monitoring.
